title: 【老闆急件】先備份並清空既有任務池，改為直接執行；全面重構派工底層
description: 老闆於 Telegram msg 1329 明確指示：第一步先對 storage/next_tasks.json 做可回復備份，之後清空既有任務；暫停把工作送進任務池，所有工作改為直接執行。接著第一個直接執行的工作是全面盤點並重構整個派工／認領／commit／殘留收斂底層，消除無人認領、無法 commit、任務池堵塞與舊機制殘留。這是 user-assigned P1 急件；須直接開工，不可只寫計畫或再拆成一般排隊單。依五步結案 gate：live 證據、根因層級、底層重構、回歸與下游回讀、制度化寫回；未全過只能標 contained。操作含清空任務池，務必先建立可驗證備份並保留回復路徑。完成後以 Telegram 回報短結論與可查證證據。
containment_evidence: Program commit 34 single-host live Supabase outage/RTO operator seam is root_cause_fixed_and_verified: durable receipt storage/ops/primary_authority_outage_rehearsal_latest.json records production 300s lease/60s renew, local demotion in 60.526s, standby recovery in 239.962s with epoch 1->2, exactly 2 successful authority claims, 0 duplicate claims, 0 effect requests/provider calls, terminal standby release, and unchanged publisher operations_core/8 fence. The overall operations-core umbrella remains contained because a physical two-Mac partition and remaining effect-family cutovers are not complete.
next_direct_step: Run both roles on two physical Macs checked out at the same commit and using the same Supabase environment: primary first, then standby with the primary epoch and same rehearsal id; collect both JSON receipts and run verify-pair. Keep the umbrella contained until storage/ops/primary_authority_outage_cross_host_latest.json passes exact read-back.
latest_checkpoint: Program commit 15 projection convergence receipt v2 closed a false-green observation gap: the hourly audit now paginates the complete same-window Supabase published projection, detects remote-only orphans as well as local-only missing rows, and still queries remote when the local window is empty. Scoped audit and schedule tests pass 11/11; a production read-only smoke returned local=14, Supabase=14, missing=0, orphan=0, live_404=0, observation_errors=0. This local root cause is fixed and verified. The umbrella remains contained: formal full-sync outbox ownership and rollback rehearsal remain, and no second physical Mac endpoint is configured for the cross-host authority pair.
